supply_registration: SUPPLY-003 (PREMISE-001/007); human_supply executed by AI with audit layer, pending external audit; explicitly NOT user supply
purpose: Two processes are identified by the theory's own identity criterion (delay equivalence forgets the arrival round), so the theory judges them the same already-completed value sequence. A declared observation layer, a race against a reference process or a bounded deadline, sees the erased round, and a declared verdict consumer then renders an explicit same/different judgement whose conclusion depends on the layer. Find whether the same identified pair yields an undecided/identical verdict under the definitional layer and a separated verdict under a purpose or availability layer, so that a verification task whose correctness depends on 'are these two the same' is decided by the very round the identity criterion erased.

source_basis.kind: AI-frozen new task family over the pinned existing delay model (GEN-001 supply, not user supply)
references: PREMISE-001/005 shard entry PREMISE-B-01 (definitional equality decidable, semantic identity pushed outside the boundary)
Atria的方案/修订片/003 (GEN-001 nine-field task specification and role discipline)
Atria的方案/修订片/011 (task-family design discipline: bounds alignment for unique BIND_CONTINUATION)
HoTT/formal/partiality-race-timeout/PartialityRaceTimeout.agda (pinned delay model; delay equivalence is the identity criterion)

input.type_ref: ground terms of Delay Bool: omega or ret n b with n <= 2 (declared grammar L1-IDENTITY-OBSERVATION-v1)
input.available_information: only what the pinned model's constructors and operations expose

environment.arrival_policy: synchronous rounds; a bind adds its own processing rounds on top of the producer's arrival round; a race returns the earlier-arriving branch, left priority on ties
environment.nondeterminism: none inside the fragment (single-thread deterministic delay)
environment.fairness: synchronous rounds with left priority on ties, as pinned

observation.value: Bool carried by ret, and Optional Bool carried by a deadline observation
observation.trace: round index n is carried by ret and accumulated by bind, but is invisible to delay equivalence (the identity criterion)
observation.time_structure: discrete synchronous rounds only; no continuity or physical-time claim

completion.criterion_ref: a declared observation layer (race against a reference delay, or a bounded deadline) observes the composed process (pair member, then verdict consumer); the verdict consumer models a verification procedure whose same/different conclusion depends on which layer observed

allowed_resources: finite enumeration budget; one native kernel check per selected witness plus positive and negative controls
prohibited_extra_information: the verdict consumer may not use information the original task was declared not to hold: no labels, no branch tags, no oracle. The observation layer and the verdict consumer are declared consumers of the same original pair and are declared up front.
assumptions: the fragment is the pinned delay model, not general identity types, general univalence or general propositional-equality metatheory

delay equivalence models the theory's identity criterion only in the bounded sense that it forgets the arrival round; this is a bounded modelling correspondence, not a claim that Delay Bool is HoTT's identity type

the race and deadline model observation layers that see the erased round only as a bounded round comparison; the verdict consumers model layer-specific same/different renderers, not semantic identity in the full theory
no physical-time or implementation claim is made
obligations: the verified statement must be a ground instance inside the declared grammar
at least one witness must bind a continuation declared only in L1-IDENTITY-OBSERVATION-v1, proving the family is outside l1-v0/v1/v2
the separating observation layer and verdict consumer must be among the declared constructs, not an oracle added after seeing a candidate
an exploration instance must not be upgraded into a new mathematical claim

known_positive_controls.note: expected separation value_mismatch: the identified pair is judged same by delay equivalence; racing both members against a reference arriving strictly between them exposes the erased round as a value difference, and the definitional verdict consumer then renders different verdicts. External benchmark only; the search is not given this answer.

expected separation deadline_observation: the purpose-layer verdict consumer adds its own processing rounds, and the deadline observes one member inside and the other outside, although the pair was identified by delay equivalence.
expected separation completion_divergence: the race exposes the erased round as a value difference and the never-on-true verdict consumer diverges on one member and completes on the other.

known_negative_controls.description: a deadline horizon at or above both raw pair-member round indices cannot separate a delay-equivalent pair without a declared verdict consumer; this is the definitional layer judging the identified pair same

correspondence.original_activity: a verification task whose correctness depends on judging whether two processes are the same, where the judgement depends on which observation layer is used
theoryization_steps: model each process as a single-thread deterministic delay, identified up to delay equivalence (this is the theory's step: the arrival round is forgotten and two result-equivalent processes are treated as the same already-completed value sequence)
model an observation layer as a declared race against a reference delay or a bounded deadline, which reads the accumulated round index the identity criterion erased
model the same/different verdict as a declared bind continuation that renders the layer's conclusion
correspondence.observation_justification: the observation layer and the verdict consumer are declared in the pinned model; the race and deadline read only the round index the model already carries
preservation_claims: the input domain, the value type and the completion requirement are unchanged from the task declaration
only the declared observation layers and verdict consumers are applied; no extra branch information is exposed
open_obligations: the Delay Bool fragment is a bounded correspondent of the B-01 definitional-equality premise, not HoTT's identity type or univalence itself; a propositional-equality or univalence family remains a V2 candidate

the family shares the race-truncation separation mechanism with the E-02 first chain and the A-03 completion-process family; cross-family independence is not proved and is registered as out-of-envelope ingress, not a conclusion
the semantic reading of 'observation layer' in the full theory is not addressed by this fragment
